_comment: PLAN-35 T05: template only. The REAL manifest is generated at image build time from the actual installed package versions -- this file documents the expected shape so a build script has a concrete target, not a value to ship as-is. Every field below with a placeholder value must be filled from the real build before this image passes readiness (section 7.6 item 2: 'No placeholder version/checksum may pass readiness').
libreoffice_version: FILL_AT_BUILD_TIME (e.g. `soffice --version` output captured during image build)
worker_build_id: FILL_AT_BUILD_TIME (git commit SHA or CI build number)
built_at: FILL_AT_BUILD_TIME (UTC ISO-8601 timestamp of the build)
